marketLayer.title: US Semiconductors & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology megacaps reiterated increased capital expenditure plans focused on AI hardware, prompting a rebound in leading chipmakers and semiconductor equipment suppliers.
marketLayer.inference: Strong commitments to AI infrastructure buildout provide near-term revenue visibility for semiconductor supply chains, bolstering investor sentiment across US growth equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential tightening of international technology export regulations and supply bottlenecks in advanced packaging.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Platform Internet Companies
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed internet leaders expanded ongoing share repurchase programs following resilient quarterly earnings reported in cloud computing and digital advertising segments.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerated share buybacks provide downside support for valuations and help restore capital confidence in the Hang Seng Tech Index.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Durability of domestic consumer spending momentum and persistent price competition in core platform sectors.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Federal Reserve Guidance
marketLayer.fact: US labor market indicators showed moderate cooling while core inflation figures met consensus expectations, reinforcing market pricing for monetary easing in the coming months.
marketLayer.inference: A clearer trajectory toward interest rate cuts lowers yield pressures, supporting cross-border liquidity and equity valuations in both US and emerging markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of re-accelerating service-sector inflation or unexpected commodity price shocks.

marketLayer.title: HK/China Electric Vehicle (EV) Sector
marketLayer.fact: Prominent Chinese EV manufacturers posted record overseas delivery figures for the month, offsetting margin compression caused by ongoing domestic promotional discounting.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas market expansion is becoming the critical driver for margin defense and top-line volume growth among top-tier EV brands.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, tariff decisions, and localized compliance demands in key export markets.
